name: PivotTableChangeList
description: Represents the list of changes a user has made to value cells in a PivotTable report based on an OLAP data source.
remarks: The PivotTableChangeList collection contains ValueChange objects that represent the changes a user has made to value cells in a PivotTable report. To return the PivotTableChangeList collection for a PivotTable, use the ChangeList property of the PivotTable object.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: When used without an object qualifier, this property returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Excel application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which this object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent PivotTable object for the specified PivotTableChangeList collection. Read-only.

properties.name: Item
properties.description: Returns a single ValueChange object from the specified PivotTableChangeList collection.

properties.name: Count
properties.description: Returns a Long value that represents the number of objects in the collection.

methods.name: Add
methods.signature: Add(Tuple As String, Value As Double, [AllocationValue As Variant], [AllocationMethod As Variant], [AllocationWeightExpression As Variant]) As ValueChange
methods.description: Adds a ValueChange object to the specified PivotTableChangeList collection.

parameters.name: Tuple
parameters.description: The MDX tuple of the value to change in the OLAP data source.

parameters.name: AllocationValue
parameters.description: The value to allocate when performing what-if analysis. If this parameter is not supplied, the default allocation value of the OLAP server will be used.

parameters.name: AllocationMethod
parameters.description: The method to use to allocate this value when performing what-if analysis. If this parameter is not supplied, the default allocation method of the OLAP server will be used.

parameters.name: AllocationWeightExpression
parameters.description: The MDX weight expression to use for this value when performing what-if analysis. If this parameter is not supplied, the default allocation weight expression of the OLAP server will be used.
